name: Lindsey Graham
office: U.S. Senator from South Carolina until 11 July 2026

former_congress.office: U.S. Representative from South Carolina's 3rd district

stance: Backs a dedicated federal regulator for AI and the largest tech platforms — the Warren-Graham commission model — to support safe AI development without stifling it.

statements.text: my two cents' worth for the Committee is that we need to empower an agency that issues them a license and can take it away.
statements.outlet: U.S. Government Publishing Office (Senate Judiciary hearing record)

statements.text: I just don't understand how you could say that you don't need an agency to deal with the most transformative technology maybe ever.
statements.outlet: U.S. Government Publishing Office (Senate Judiciary hearing record)

statements.text: With Sens. Warren, Bennet, and Welch, urged the Majority Leader to back a new agency to regulate digital platforms and AI; with Warren he introduced the Digital Consumer Protection Commission Act to establish such a commission.
Today's challenge calls for a dedicated and nimble agency that is able to keep measured pace with the speed of innovation, supporting safe development without stifling it
You're going to have to have national standards, or else you'll drive everybody crazy
We gotta have some guardrails on how to develop the technology, but if you lock it down and have too much government, you're going to be left behind
